requirement_text: All TV amplifiers without automatic gain control have also be checked similarly.
rationale: The sentence depends on an earlier check that is not given and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What exactly was checked on the TV amplifiers with automatic gain control, and how?

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to access the system using specified pincodes (zones).
user_story: As a user, I want to access the system using specified pincodes (zones), so that I only see my zone.
technical_task: Control access to the system by the specified pincodes (zones).
acceptance_criteria: Given a user in a specified pincode zone, when the user accesses the system, then access is granted for that zone.
Given a pincode that is not specified, when a user tries to access the system with it, then access is not granted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion follows from "specified pincodes".

requirement_text: System shall ensure availability 24/7, informing users and preventing them from continuing in case of unexpected failures.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available 24/7 and to be told and stopped from continuing when an unexpected failure occurs, so that I don't proceed on a broken system.
technical_task: Keep the system available 24/7 and, on an unexpected failure, inform users and stop them from continuing.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given an unexpected failure, when it occurs, then users are informed and cannot continue.

requirement_text: System shall be able to allow new users to register and create accounts.
user_story: As a new user, I want to register and create an account, so that I can use the system.
technical_task: Provide registration and account creation for new users.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when a new user submits valid details, then an account is created.
Given the registration form, when a new user submits invalid details, then no account is created.

requirement_text: Access to editing booking, billing, and car information shall be limited to authorized personnel.
user_story: As a rental manager, I want access to editing booking, billing and car information limited to authorized personnel, so that records stay correct.
technical_task: Restrict editing of booking, billing and car information to authorized personnel.
acceptance_criteria: Given authorized personnel, when they edit booking, billing or car information, then the edit is saved.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to edit that information, then the edit is refused.

requirement_text: In the event of remote Deck Lid lid release, the ITS monitoring is interrupted until the Deck Lid is closed again.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the ITS monitoring interrupted during a remote Deck Lid release until the Deck Lid is closed again, so that opening the lid does not trigger false alarms.
technical_task: Suspend the ITS monitoring when the Deck Lid is released remotely and resume it when the Deck Lid is closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Deck Lid is released remotely, when the release occurs, then the ITS monitoring is interrupted.
Given the ITS monitoring is interrupted because of a remote release, when the Deck Lid is closed again, then the interruption ends.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The resume criterion follows from "until".

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create, schedule, track, and manage tasks related to sales activities.
user_story: As a salesperson, I want to create, schedule, track and manage tasks related to sales activities, so that I stay organized.
technical_task: Provide task creation, scheduling, tracking and management for sales activities.
acceptance_criteria: Given the task function, when a user creates a task related to a sales activity, then it is saved.
Given a task, when a user schedules, tracks or manages it, then the changes are applied.

requirement_text: User shall be able to initialize parameters (t, k, m, n) and set the parameters during the initialization process.
user_story: As a user, I want to initialize parameters (t, k, m, n) and set them during initialization, so that the algorithm starts with my values.
technical_task: Provide an initialization step in which the parameters t, k, m and n can be entered and set.
acceptance_criteria: Given the initialization step, when the user enters values for t, k, m and n, then the parameters are set.
Given the parameters have been set, when initialization completes, then they are used by the system.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The meaning of the parameters is not described.

requirement_text: User shall perform weekly roster of employees.
user_story: As a manager, I want to prepare a weekly roster of employees, so that shifts are planned.
technical_task: Provide weekly roster creation for employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given employees, when the user prepares a weekly roster, then the roster is saved.
Given a saved weekly roster, when it is opened, then it shows the employees' assignments.
rationale: Role assumed: manager; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: When the radio is first powered on, the language that appears on the display shall be the default one set by the national railway. (M) Select mobile radio network.
requirement_text_raw:
When the radio is first powered on, the language that appears on the display shall be 
the default one set by the national railway. (M) 
Select mobile radio network.
user_story: As a railway driver, I want the display language to be the default one set by the national railway when the radio is first powered on, and to select the mobile radio network, so that the radio is ready to use.
technical_task: Show the display in the language the national railway set as default when the radio is first powered on, and offer selection of the mobile radio network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the radio is powered on for the first time, when the display starts, then it uses the default language set by the national railway.
Given the radio is powered on, when the user opens network settings, then a mobile radio network can be selected.
rationale: Role assumed: railway driver. The "(M)" tag is kept out of the behaviour.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall issue the 50 Hz interrupt to all the ICPs with a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS191] issue the 50 Hz interrupt to all the ICPs with a skew no greater than 330 microseconds.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to issue the 50 Hz interrupt to all ICPs with a skew of no more than 330 microseconds, so that they stay in step.
technical_task: Send the 50 Hz interrupt from the scheduler to every ICP so that the skew between ICPs is at most 330 microseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 50 Hz interrupt is issued, when it reaches all ICPs, then the skew between them is no greater than 330 microseconds.
Given a skew above 330 microseconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: SSL is used to protect authentication cookies.
user_story: As a security officer, I want SSL used to protect authentication cookies, so that they cannot be stolen in transit.
technical_task: Send authentication cookies only over SSL.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authentication cookie, when it is sent, then it is sent over SSL.
Given a connection without SSL, when an authentication cookie would be sent, then it is not sent.

requirement_text: When the task restart begins, the FTSS shall provide a mechanism to signal the task to execute its startup recovery actions, including updating the I-Load data and pre-stored last good data state.
requirement_text_raw: When the task restart begins, the FTSS shall (3.3.4.15) provide a mechanism to signal the task to execute its startup recovery actions, including updating the I-Load data and pre-stored last good data state.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to signal a task at restart to run its startup recovery actions, including updating the I-Load data and the pre-stored last good data state, so that the task recovers correctly.
technical_task: When a task restart begins, give a mechanism that signals the task to execute startup recovery actions, including updating I-Load data and the pre-stored last good data state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task restart begins, when FTSS handles it, then the task is signalled to execute its startup recovery actions.
Given the startup recovery actions run, when they complete, then the I-Load data and the pre-stored last good data state have been updated.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to generate asset reports based on location.
user_story: As an asset manager, I want asset reports by location, so that I can see where assets are.
technical_task: Generate asset reports grouped by location.
acceptance_criteria: Given assets at several locations, when the user generates a report, then assets are shown per location.
Given a location with no assets, when the report is generated, then it shows no assets for that location.

requirement_text: The system shall provide textual descriptions or alternative functionalities for all non-text media like images and videos.
user_story: As a user who cannot see images or videos, I want textual descriptions or alternative functionalities for all non-text media, so that I can access the content.
technical_task: Provide a textual description or an alternative function for every image and video.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image, when it is displayed, then a textual description or alternative function is available.
Given a video, when it is displayed, then a textual description or alternative function is available.
rationale: Role assumed: user needing accessibility support.

requirement_text: System shall allow up to three reattempts for unsuccessful login and display supported languages for successful login.
user_story: As a user, I want up to three reattempts after an unsuccessful login and to see the supported languages after a successful login, so that I can sign in and choose a language.
technical_task: Allow at most three reattempts after an unsuccessful login and display the supported languages after a successful login.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unsuccessful login, when the user retries, then up to three reattempts are allowed.
Given a successful login, when it completes, then the supported languages are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What happens after the third failed reattempt is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall be able to facilitate fund transfers between accounts.
user_story: As a customer, I want to transfer funds between accounts, so that I can move my money.
technical_task: Provide a fund transfer function between accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given two accounts and sufficient funds, when the customer transfers funds, then the amount is moved from one account to the other.
Given insufficient funds, when the customer tries to transfer, then the transfer is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The admin or user can log in to the system with their unique username and password.
user_story: As an admin or user, I want to log in with my unique username and password, so that I can access the system.
technical_task: Provide login with a unique username and password for admins and users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid unique username and password, when the admin or user logs in, then access is granted.
Given an invalid username or password, when the admin or user logs in, then access is denied.

requirement_text: User shall commit all data storage for user variables to the database at the time of entry for reliability.
user_story: As a user, I want all data for my user variables committed to the database when I enter it, so that nothing is lost.
technical_task: Write user variable data to the database at the moment of entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters data for a user variable, when it is entered, then it is committed to the database immediately.
Given a system restart after entry, when the data is read, then the entered data is still present.

requirement_text: FTSS shall , in ICP and FCP IBIT failure cases that allow processing to continue, after saving the results of IBIT for reporting to the application, in the first minor frame after Startup or recovery, consider the FCR to be failed, and start performing recovery actions for the FCR.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS290], in ICP and FCP IBIT failure cases that allow processing to continue, after saving the results of IBIT for reporting to the application, in the first minor frame after Startup or recovery, consider the FCR to be failed, and start performing recovery actions for the FCR.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FTSS to treat the FCR as failed and start recovery in the first minor frame after startup or recovery when IBIT fails in a way that allows processing to continue, so that the FCR is recovered.
technical_task: After saving the IBIT results for reporting to the application, mark the FCR as failed and begin recovery actions in the first minor frame after startup or recovery, for ICP and FCP IBIT failures that allow processing to continue.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP or FCP IBIT failure that allows processing to continue, when the results of IBIT have been saved, then FTSS considers the FCR failed in the first minor frame after startup or recovery.
Given the FCR is considered failed, when this happens, then FTSS starts performing recovery actions for it.

requirement_text: Synchronous communication shall be in the form of messages enqueued for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame and dequeued for reading by the recipient task within the next rate group frame after it is received.
requirement_text_raw: Synchronous communication shall (3.3.6.1) be in the form of messages enqueued for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame and dequeued for reading by the recipient task within the next rate group frame after it is received.
user_story: As a software developer, I want synchronous communication done with messages queued at the start of the next rate group frame and read by the recipient in the next frame after receipt, so that exchanges are deterministic.
technical_task: Implement synchronous communication by enqueuing messages for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame and dequeuing them for the recipient task within the next rate group frame after receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message to send, when synchronous communication is used, then it is enqueued for transmission at the start of the next rate group frame.
Given a received message, when the recipient task reads, then it is dequeued within the next rate group frame after it is received.

requirement_text: User shall be able to learn about sponsorship levels, to determine appropriate sponsorship.
user_story: As a prospective sponsor, I want to learn about the sponsorship levels, so that I can choose an appropriate one.
technical_task: Show information about each sponsorship level.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sponsorship page, when the user opens it, then the sponsorship levels are listed.
Given a sponsorship level, when the user selects it, then its details are shown.

requirement_text: The system shall allow trainers to create new courses and events.
user_story: As a trainer, I want to create new courses and events, so that I can offer training.
technical_task: Allow trainers to create courses and events.
acceptance_criteria: Given a trainer, when the trainer creates a course, then it is saved.
Given a trainer, when the trainer creates an event, then it is saved.

requirement_text: A Moderator shall be able to limit the number of nodes that an individual user can create.
user_story: As a moderator, I want to limit how many nodes an individual user can create, so that no user overloads the system.
technical_task: Provide a per-user limit on node creation that moderators can set.
acceptance_criteria: Given a moderator sets a limit, when a user has reached it, then the user cannot create more nodes.
Given a user below the limit, when the user creates a node, then it is created.

requirement_text: The final product is a site where health care workers can access important patient information the non-emergency access can be controlled and all access would be tracked.
requirement_text_raw: The final product is a site where health care workers can access important patient information  the non-emergency access can be controlled  and all access would be tracked.
rationale: The sentence describes the final product in general terms and gives no specific behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a product description rather than a requirement?
What must the system do for non-emergency access control and tracking?

requirement_text: System shall only provide security for the computer and devices belonging to the user.
rationale: The sentence limits the scope of security without saying what protection is required.
clarification_questions: Does this exclude protection of other systems and data?
What security is to be provided for the user's computer and devices?

requirement_text: A Layer 4 firewall with anomaly detection possibly and possibly heuristics capabilities is recommended.
user_story: As a network security engineer, I want a Layer 4 firewall with anomaly detection and possibly heuristics, so that threats are filtered.
technical_task: Recommend a Layer 4 firewall with anomaly detection and, optionally, heuristics capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given the network design, when it is reviewed, then a Layer 4 firewall with anomaly detection is included.
Given the firewall, when heuristics capabilities are available, then they are enabled; otherwise this is acceptable because they are optional.
rationale: Role assumed: network security engineer. "Recommended" and "possibly" make the heuristics optional.

requirement_text: The product shall use symbols and words that are naturally understandable by the realtor community.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall use symbols and words that are naturally understandable by the realtor community.'
rationale: "Naturally understandable" is subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which symbols and words are "naturally understandable" to realtors?

requirement_text: The useful operating service life shall (3.2.3.1.3.10.2.1) be a minimum of 30,000 hours.
user_story: As a mission manager, I want a useful operating service life of at least 30,000 hours, so that the unit lasts through the mission.
technical_task: Design the unit for a useful operating service life of at least 30,000 hours (3.2.3.1.3.10.2.1).
acceptance_criteria: Given the unit in operation, when its service life is assessed, then it is at least 30,000 hours.
Given an assessed life below 30,000 hours, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: For further details please contact Kleer.
rationale: The sentence only tells the reader to contact a party.
clarification_questions: What details should be obtained from Kleer?
Is this a requirement for the system or a contact note?

requirement_text: The user shall be able to check a box on "Resit" if they are giving the exam again.
user_story: As a student, I want to tick a box on Resit when I am taking the exam again, so that my attempt is recorded as a resit.
technical_task: Add a checkbox on the "Resit" screen that marks the exam as a repeat attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Resit screen, when the user checks the box, then the exam is recorded as a resit.
Given the Resit screen, when the user leaves the box unchecked, then the exam is recorded as a first attempt.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access reports containing details of research projects classified as sensitive or highly sensitive.
user_story: As a research manager, I want to access reports on research projects classified as sensitive or highly sensitive, so that I can review them.
technical_task: Provide reports for projects classified as sensitive or highly sensitive.
acceptance_criteria: Given a project classified as sensitive or highly sensitive, when a user opens its report, then the report details are shown.
Given a report, when it is shown, then it contains details of the research project.

requirement_text: User shall benefit from 256-Bit SSL encryption for secure data transmission in WhatsApp.
user_story: As a WhatsApp user, I want 256-Bit SSL encryption for data transmission, so that my messages are secure.
technical_task: Use 256-Bit SSL encryption for all data transmission in WhatsApp.
acceptance_criteria: Given data transmitted in WhatsApp, when it is sent, then it uses 256-Bit SSL encryption.
Given a connection that does not use 256-Bit SSL encryption, when data would be sent, then it is not transmitted.

requirement_text: User shall be able to see a list of all summits, to explore available options.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to see a list of all summits, so that I can explore the options.
technical_task: Display the list of all summits.
acceptance_criteria: Given summits exist, when the user opens the list, then all summits are shown.
Given a summit in the list, when the user selects it, then more information is available.

requirement_text: A flexible service-based architecture shall be implemented to facilitate future extensions.
clarification_questions: What makes the architecture "flexible" in testable terms?

requirement_text: The iTrust user (LHCP or ER) has authenticated himself or herself in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
user_story: As an iTrust user (LHCP or ER), I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can use it (UC3).
technical_task: Authenticate the iTrust user (LHCP or ER) in the iTrust Medical Records system before use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP or ER with valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated.
Given a user without valid credentials, when the user logs in, then authentication fails.
rationale: Role stated: iTrust user (LHCP or ER). The sentence states a precondition of use case UC3.

requirement_text: The system shall implement an Elasticsearch cluster to facilitate full-text search functionalities.
user_story: As a user, I want full-text search, so that I can find content quickly.
technical_task: Run an Elasticsearch cluster to provide full-text search.
acceptance_criteria: Given indexed content, when the user searches for a word, then results containing it are returned.
Given the system's search service, when it is reviewed, then it is based on an Elasticsearch cluster.

requirement_text: The solution should enforce solution and data access rules for all EMR resources (at component application or user level either local or remote).
requirement_text_raw: The solution should enforce solution and data access rules for all EMR resources (at component  application  or user level  either local or remote).
user_story: As a security officer, I want solution and data access rules enforced for all EMR resources at component, application or user level, locally or remotely, so that access is controlled everywhere.
technical_task: Enforce access rules for all EMR resources at component, application or user level, for local and remote access.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EMR resource, when a local user requests access, then the access rules are enforced.
Given an EMR resource, when a remote user requests access, then the access rules are enforced.

requirement_text: System shall validate data integrity and format compliance.
user_story: As a data steward, I want data validated for integrity and format compliance, so that bad data is caught.
technical_task: Check data integrity and format compliance on input.
acceptance_criteria: Given data with a wrong format, when it is validated, then the format problem is reported.
Given data that is not intact, when it is validated, then the integrity problem is reported.

requirement_text: Agency user shall have all historical Financial Assistance data loaded for FABS go-live for completeness.
user_story: As an agency user, I want all historical Financial Assistance data loaded for FABS go-live, so that the data is complete.
technical_task: Load all historical Financial Assistance data into FABS before go-live.
acceptance_criteria: Given FABS go-live, when it takes place, then all historical Financial Assistance data has been loaded.
Given historical Financial Assistance data, when it is checked after loading, then no records are missing.

requirement_text: PN may be superimposed by a larger error offset due to incorrect stored face proportions according to AGMR-1315.
rationale: The sentence describes a possible error effect and refers to an unexplained signal and document.
clarification_questions: What does PN stand for and what must the system do about the error offset?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see the initial interface if no user is detected.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the initial interface when no user is detected, so that the device shows a start screen.
technical_task: Show the initial interface when no user is detected.
acceptance_criteria: Given no user is detected, when the device is active, then the initial interface is shown.
Given a user is detected, when the device is active, then the initial interface is no longer the only screen shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Security and privacy in the mobility domain shall be prioritized by the system, ensuring transparency and trust.
clarification_questions: What does "prioritized" mean for security and privacy, and how are transparency and trust measured?
Which functions of the mobility domain are meant?

requirement_text: User shall view examination schedules and details.
user_story: As a student, I want to view examination schedules and details, so that I know when and where exams are.
technical_task: Display examination schedules and the details of each exam.
acceptance_criteria: Given scheduled examinations, when the user opens the schedule, then the examination schedules are shown.
Given an examination in the schedule, when the user selects it, then its details are shown.

requirement_text: If after a failure confirmation the Ignition is not on AND EF_Actv is off for longer than PPNM_HWDecErrIgnIffTime the emergency mode is left, the redundancy supply is switched off and the backup relay is not longer actuated.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the emergency mode left, the redundancy supply switched off and the backup relay no longer actuated when, after a failure confirmation, the ignition is not on and EF_Actv is off for longer than PPNM_HWDecErrIgnIffTime, so that the vehicle returns to a safe state.
technical_task: Leave the emergency mode, switch off the redundancy supply and stop actuating the backup relay when the ignition is not on and EF_Actv is off for longer than PPNM_HWDecErrIgnIffTime after a failure confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure confirmation, when the ignition is not on and EF_Actv is off for longer than PPNM_HWDecErrIgnIffTime, then the emergency mode is left.
Given the emergency mode is left, when the condition holds, then the redundancy supply is switched off and the backup relay is no longer actuated.

requirement_text: Automated responses to job applications shall be provided.
user_story: As an applicant, I want an automated response to my job application, so that I know it was received.
technical_task: Send an automated response to every submitted job application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job application is submitted, when it is received, then an automated response is sent to the applicant.
Given several applications, when they are submitted, then each applicant receives an automated response.

requirement_text: User shall be able to check transaction history and keep records.
user_story: As a customer, I want to check my transaction history and keep records, so that I can review my activity.
technical_task: Provide a transaction history view and a way to keep records.
acceptance_criteria: Given past transactions, when the user opens the history, then the transactions are listed.
Given a transaction in the history, when the user keeps it as a record, then it is stored.

requirement_text: Returning to the Billing Report and clicking 'Update List' you can see that the status of the billable encounter has been updated.
requirement_text_raw: Returning to the Billing Report and clicking 'Update List'  you can see that the status of the billable encounter has been updated.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to return to the Billing Report and click Update List to see the updated status of a billable encounter, so that I can confirm the update.
technical_task: Refresh the Billing Report when Update List is clicked so the billable encounter shows its updated status.
acceptance_criteria: Given a billable encounter whose status has been updated, when the clerk clicks Update List in the Billing Report, then the encounter shows the updated status.
Given the Billing Report, when Update List has not been clicked, then the list may still show the old status.

requirement_text: The web-based displays defined by the ASPERA-3 team to be used for science analysis shall be password protected until the ASPERA-3 data is made public.
user_story: As a project owner, I want the ASPERA-3 web-based displays used for science analysis password protected until the ASPERA-3 data is made public, so that unpublished data stays private.
technical_task: Protect the ASPERA-3 web-based displays with a password until the ASPERA-3 data is made public.
acceptance_criteria: Given the ASPERA-3 data is not yet public, when a user opens a web-based display, then a password is required.
Given the ASPERA-3 data has been made public, when a user opens a web-based display, then no password is required.
rationale: Role assumed: project owner. The second criterion follows from "until".

requirement_text: User shall experience optimal performance above 40 kbps internet speed.
user_story: As a user, I want optimal performance when my internet speed is above 40 kbps, so that the application works smoothly.
technical_task: Make the application perform optimally on internet connections faster than 40 kbps.
acceptance_criteria: Given an internet speed above 40 kbps, when the user uses the application, then it performs optimally.
Given an internet speed of 40 kbps or lower, when the user uses the application, then performance is not guaranteed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Optimal" is not measured.
